<b>Stilkin Trappers</b> are [[Enemies (Silksong)|enemies]] in <i>[[Hollow Knight: Silksong]]</i>. They are trap setting members of the [[Stilkin Tribe|Stilkin]] who carry a pouch of sharpened long-stakes.<ref>Stilkin Trapper Hunter's Journal entry: <i>"Trap setting bug carrying a pouch of sharpened long-stakes."</i></ref>

== Behaviour and Tactics ==
Stilkin Trappers always start off hidden, and may leap out of the infested waters when Hornet comes near, indicated by droplets being kicked up from where they are.<br>
Stilkin Trappers will jump out of the water and perform a long, fluttering jump. If Hornet is beneath them at any point of the flutter, they will throw 3 stakes directly downwards, jumping up very slightly with each one.<br>
Once they land from a flutter jump, they will either dive down if they land in infested waters, or, if they land on a platform, they will jump away from Hornet and then dive to reappear again later.

Stilkin Trappers deal 50 damage to enemies that are hit with their stakes.  

An easy way to kill them is to jump to their height and use [[Cross Stitch]] as they make contact with Hornet, or using [[Delver's Drill]].

== [[Needolin]] Dialogue ==
{{SS Needolin|columns=2|
* They fall! We rise!
* They wither! We survive!
* Their shadow... our shame...
* Our land! Their grave!
* Flowing poison... hidden claw...
* Dark... twisting... betrayal's heart...
}}

== Location ==
Stilkin Trappers can initially be encountered in [[Groal the Great]]'s arena as part of the pre-fight [[Enemy_Gauntlets_(Silksong)#Bilehaven|gauntlet]] and as minions summoned by the boss. After Groal the Great is defeated, they start to spawn in northern Bilewater.
